set_all_seeds: set random seeds for python, numpy, and torch using a single seed value
init_net: initialize a PyTorch neural network with orthogonal weights or load from a checkpoint file
flatten_first2dim: flatten the first two dimensions of a PyTorch tensor or dict of tensors into one
tensor_slice: slice a PyTorch tensor or dict of tensors along a specified dimension with start and end indices
one_hot: create a one-hot encoded tensor from a column vector of class indices with n classes
